title: Coordinate boxes in the span of an orthonormal frame have H^k-measure (2r)^k
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ and let g = (g_1, …, g_k) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P with span G := span{g_1, …, g_k}; H^k := μHE[k]. Then for every r > 0, the closed box {t ∈ G : |⟨g_i, t⟩| ≤ r for all i} and the open box {t ∈ G : |⟨g_i, t⟩| < r for all i} both have H^k-measure ENNReal.ofReal((2r)^k).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (g : Fin k → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ g → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → μHE[k] {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r} = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * r) ^ k) ∧ μHE[k] {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| < r} = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * r) ^ k)
